description: **FULL-SIZE REPLICA — FLAG THIS.** A walk-through reproduction of the Pan American Airways Boeing 314 "Yankee Clipper" with reconstructed flight deck; navigation and radio room; dining saloon; passenger seating and sleeping berths and lavatories — all photographed in detail by geograph.org.uk contributors and captioned by them as a replica. **No original Boeing 314 survives anywhere in the world.** No registration exists for the replica and none must be assigned
